maculaStatus: Foveal reflex present; subtle thickening noted on clinical exam. Clinically significant macular edema (CSME) cannot be excluded without OCT.

recommendation: Refer to retinal specialist within 2 weeks. Optimize glycemic and blood pressure control. Schedule fluorescein angiography to confirm macular involvement.
analysisSummary: The AI model identified characteristics consistent with moderate non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy (NPDR). Key vascular lesions including microaneurysms, hemorrhages, and exudates are localized primarily in the temporal quadrant. The absence of neovascularization suggests the disease has not yet progressed to the proliferative stage, but macular edema risk remains elevated. Prompt specialist review is advised.
differentialConsiderations: Hypertensive retinopathy excluded based on lack of AV nicking and flame-shaped hemorrhages. Branch retinal vein occlusion considered but distribution pattern is inconsistent with a single vessel territory. Radiation retinopathy unlikely without exposure history.
